purpose: Name the most likely reviewer objections and required evidence before treating the grounded-QA distillation project as paper-ready.

risks.reviewer_objection: The paper question asks whether expensive grounded behavior can be distilled into a cheaper trained model or scaffold, but the final Qwen 3B joint-action student has not been trained/evaluated.
risks.mitigation_done: The dataset packet, bounded GPU runner, adapter eval, smoke manifest, and budgeted launch command are prepared and validated. joint-action-packet-quality-audit-2026-06-26-v1 verifies 244 SFT rows and 80 DPO rows with both repair and abstain preferences, no missing inline citations in grounded targets, and no train/eval paper overlap. joint-action-script-contract-audit-2026-06-26-v1 runs zero-cost local compile, packet-validator, Bash syntax, bounded-command, and judge-ready artifact checks. model-scale-adequacy-audit-2026-06-26-v1 shows tiny/local students are not adequate final evidence and justifies the bounded Qwen 3B smoke over either tiny-model labelers or an open-ended cutting-edge GPU run. qwen3b-local-control-non-substitution-audit-2026-06-26-v1 invokes the production integrity/provenance gates against the local Qwen base and citation-repair controls and confirms both are rejected as final trained-smoke substitutes. qwen3b-remote-provenance-gate-joint-action-qwen3b-smoke-eval-v1 requires pod status, remote environment, bootstrap manifest, and bounded smoke manifest provenance before any paid judge or Pareto claim. qwen3b-result-integration-joint-action-smoke-2026-06-26-v1 will compare the judged Qwen result against direct and 70% coverage-constrained targets before any Pareto claim; qwen3b-integration-fixture-audit-2026-06-26-v1 verifies its negative/minimum-positive/strong-positive status logic, and qwen3b-syntax-only-rejection-audit-2026-06-26-v1 verifies that perfect inline citation syntax alone is rejected. final-evidence-checklist-qwen3b-2026-06-26-v1 enumerates the exact final artifacts that must exist before this blocker can close.

risks.reviewer_objection: The motivating claim says private evolving KBs, while the current evaluation is a public QASPER/arXiv proxy.
risks.mitigation_done: corpus-realism-private-kb-gap-audit-2026-06-26-v1 makes the boundary executable: it allows an evolving public domain-KB proxy claim, rejects private-enterprise proof and WriteBack-memory-baseline claims, and lists the required versioned private-KB upgrade evidence. versioned-private-kb-prototype-git-docs-2026-06-26-v1 makes that upgrade path concrete by producing 30 deterministic examples from immutable repo git snapshots, including stale-snapshot abstentions, while still marking private-enterprise proof as unsupported. versioned-private-kb-eval-versioned-private-kb-prototype-git-docs-2026-06-26-v1 evaluates that slice and shows naive citation-copy fails stale-snapshot abstentions while a snapshot-aware prefix retriever solves the deterministic prototype. versioned-kb-naturalness-audit-versioned-private-kb-prototype-git-docs-2026-06-26-v1 measures the original natural-benchmark gap: 100.0% template question wording and 100.0% quoted-prefix leakage. versioned-kb-natural-questions-versioned-private-kb-prototype-git-docs-2026-06-26-v2 runs a ledgered natural-question authoring probe for 30 examples at $0.001607, reducing template wording to 0.0%, snapshot labels to 0.0%, and prefix leakage to 3.3%. versioned-kb-natural-question-eval-versioned-kb-natural-questions-versioned-private-kb-prototype-git-docs-2026-06-26-v2 then evaluates that natural-question surface with zero calls: naive citation-copy remains at 50.0% overall correctness and fails stale-snapshot abstentions, while the lexical snapshot guard reaches 96.7% overall correctness with one stable-question retrieval miss. Natural/private benchmark claims remain false until retrieval packs, natural insufficiency cases, and private/enterprise semantics are added. The manuscript evidence map and draft restrict the claim to a trusted dated public proxy and explicitly prohibit private-KB proof language.
required_next_evidence: Keep the manuscript caveat unless a versioned private/domain corpus is added.
Replace deterministic line-prefix questions with natural questions and snapshot-specific retrieval packs before claiming a natural versioned-KB benchmark.
If adding a private KB, create train-time and final-time snapshots with immutable date provenance.
If comparing write-back memory, allow writes only from prior snapshots and preserve derived-record provenance.

risks.reviewer_objection: The contribution may be perceived as generic RAG distillation, generic citation SFT, or KB write-back memory rather than a sharper grounded-correctness amortization result.
risks.mitigation_done: Current artifacts isolate the support/abstention/citation-grounding axis and scope out full WriteBack retrieval on QASPER until leakage-safe memory snapshots exist. versioned-kb-writeback-diagnostic-versioned-private-kb-prototype-git-docs-2026-06-26-v1 adds a small versioned-domain diagnostic: leak-safe train-only write-back reaches 60.0% overall correctness but 0.0% correctness on eval-update questions, train write-back plus live snapshot reaches 100.0% on the deterministic slice, and the leaky eval-written upper bound answers 100.0% of stale-snapshot queries with 0.0% correctness. That supports the claim boundary: WriteBack is a close amortization neighbor, but fair comparison requires snapshot-safe provenance and should not be counted as a completed natural benchmark baseline yet.
required_next_evidence: Refresh web/paper search immediately before any submission claim.
Update related-work notes with any June 2026 or newer direct overlaps.

risks.reviewer_objection: A model-based grounded-correctness judge can be biased, under-calibrated, or insufficient as the only correctness authority.
risks.mitigation_done: The judge artifacts store structured support verdicts, judge-calibration-audit-2026-06-26-v1 samples 26 hard rows from 447 existing judgments, judge-adjudication-packet-2026-06-26-v1 joins those rows to questions/evidence/predictions with 0 join warnings, judge-reliability-second-pass-plan-2026-06-26-v1 prepares 26 blind second-pass request rows, judge-reliability-second-pass-run-2026-06-26-v2 completes 42 blind second-pass case judgments with 0 schema violations and 76.2% exact agreement, and abstention-boundary-reliability-audit-2026-06-26-v1 flags questionable abstentions as unstable. judge-disagreement-taxonomy-judge-reliability-second-pass-run-2026-06-26-v2 classifies the 23.8% disagreement slice: 6 abstention-boundary reversals, 2 partial/support granularity reversals, and 2 unsupported-to-supported reversals.
required_next_evidence: Manually adjudicate the joined judge adjudication packet or run the planned blind second-judge pass before submission if budget/time permits.
Report judge prompts, schemas, abstention criteria, and disagreement examples.

risks.reviewer_objection: The strongest completed scaffold results improve support largely by suppressing risky answers, so correctness gains may hide poor answer coverage.
risks.mitigation_done: cost-coverage-support-pareto-2026-06-26-v1 maps 6 current systems across answer rate, answer support, judged correctness, citation recall, and online calls/query; post-training-policy-ablation-2026-06-26-v1 aggregates existing judged post-training/data policies and shows support-risk gated labels are strongest by judged correctness/support but answer only 57.6% of rows; coverage-constrained-support-frontier-2026-06-26-v1 replays thresholds and shows the 70% answer-rate operating point reaches 68.5% answer support and 77.3% judged correctness; the draft frames coverage as a central metric.
required_next_evidence: Report answer rate, abstention correctness, support, and utility together.
Compare trained Qwen 3B against zero-call gates on both correctness and coverage.
Use qwen3b-result-integration to decide whether the result meets the minimum target or is a negative result.

risks.reviewer_objection: The paper may be underpowered if the student model is too small, or wasteful if it jumps to an expensive cutting-edge model without first testing the minimal credible trained student.
risks.mitigation_done: model-scale-adequacy-audit-2026-06-26-v1 compares direct mini RAG, zero-call gates, local distilled scaffolds, Qwen 0.5B SFT, the local Qwen 3B base-control, and a zero-call Qwen 3B citation-repair control. It records that Qwen 0.5B has high citation formatting but only 5.0% answer support, while Qwen 3B base inference answers many prompts but has weak inline-citation contract adherence. The deterministic repair reaches 100.0% inline citation rate without proving support. qwen3b-local-control-non-substitution-audit-2026-06-26-v1 then verifies those local controls also fail the production final-smoke gates because they lack the canonical run id, trained adapter, full 69-example final window, smoke manifest, and remote provenance. Together these audits reject tiny/base/syntax-repaired outputs as final students or ground-truth labelers and select a bounded Qwen 3B joint-action LoRA smoke as the next minimum credible trained-student experiment under the $100 cap.
required_next_evidence: Run the bounded Qwen 3B smoke only after auth_and_live_price_verified.
If Qwen 3B fails the 70% coverage-constrained target, report that negative result before escalating to a larger model.
Do not use tiny local model outputs as ground-truth labels.
